newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-MATCHES IN THE ITALIAN LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MATCHES IN THE ITALIAN LEAGUE CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: The following matches are being played in the Italian league championship on Sunday(league positions in parentheses, all kickoff times GMT)

Atalanta have picked up 15 points in a seven match unbeaten run since the beginning of December and should add to that haul against third from bottom Cagliari. Atalanta's Filippo Inzaghi, the league's leading goalscorer with 12 goals, and ex-AC Milan striker Gigi Lentini are expected to recover from midweek knocks. Cagliari rely on Uruguyans Fabian O'Neill and Dario Silva along with Sandro Tovalieri in attack.

English midfielder Paul Ince is expected to return at the expense of Dutchman Aron Winter for a game Inter need to win, following a 2-0 home defeat by Bologna last Sunday. Maurizio Ganz and Marco Branca lead the Inter attack while Udinese look to Paolo Poggi and Brazilian Amoroso in attack, the latter a replacement for injured German striker Oliver Bierhoff.

This should be easy for the leaders at home to the bottom side. With Alessandro Del Piero suspended and Croat striker Alen Boksic out until March, Nicola Amoruso and Michele Padovano take over in attack. Reggiana rely on the experience of ex-AC Milan trio Fernando De Napoli, Gianluca Sordo and Filippo Galli along with Rumanian Ioan Sabau.

Beaten 2-0 by Juventus last week, Lazio could be in for another difficult day against in-form Bologna. Unsettled captain Giuseppe Signori leads the attack alongside Gigi Casiraghi and Roberto Rambaudi, while suspended Argentine defender Jose Chamot is replaced by Alessandro Grandoni. Full strength Bologna may start with Davide Fontolan alongside Swede Kennet Andersson in attack.

Four successive wins against AC Milan, Juventus, Bologna and Verona have seen Parma jump from the relegation zone to just off the championship pace. With Croat Mario Stanic alongside Argentine Nestor Sensini in midfield and with Enrico Chiesa and Argentine Hernan Crespo in attack, Parma may get another good result against a Napoli side led by Brazilian libero-turned- midfielder Andre Cruz.

Roma's indifferent season continued apace last week with a last minute 1-0 away defeat by Udinese and they will be anxious to avoid a repeat here. Injured Argentine Abel Balbo will be replaced by Marco Delvecchio alongside Francesco Totti in the Roma attack, while all-Italian relegation battlers Piacenza rely on Pasquale Luiso and Gian Pietro Piovani in attack.

In-form Sampdoria have picked up 13 points in their last five games and will be keen to avenge their 1-0 defeat by Perugia on the opening day of the season. Roberto Mancini and Vincenzo Montella, with 21 goals between them, lead the attack against a Perugia side that may be on the road to recovery under new coach, Nevio Scala.

Roberto Baggio reclaims his place in the Milan attack alongside Frenchman Christophe Dugarry. Swede Jesper Blomqvist, Frenchman Marcel Desailly and Croat Zvonimir Boban compensate for the suspended Demetrio Albertini in midfield. Verona field Nicola Zanini and Filippo Maniero in attack.

Fiorentina will be looking to avenge a 4-2 home drubbing by Vicenza on the opening day of the season. Full strength Fiorentina are led by Argentine Gabriel Batistuta along with Brazilian Oliveira in attack while Vicenza field Uruguyan striker-cum midfielder Marcelo Otero, the man who scored all four goals last September.
